comment: ROAD TRIP (PORT-82, design/ROAD_TRIP.md, port ADR-087, ADR-092): the remaster's roguelike mode. icons from 40 are trip_gear_icons_2.png, hazards from 5 trip_hazard_icons_2.png. sets: items that together add stats. diner: dishes for the next match. rival: the ROAD HOGS. talks (port ADR-104): the conversations heard again, after the first one in scenes: four more each, in order, one per meeting, a character saying more of themselves each time (teams by ladder index, start/motel/diner by partner with Pepper -1, the ROAD HOGS by their arc). beats: the story across trips, each once, at its slot, when its conditions hold (RoadTrip.beat_due). legs: three stretches of road, each with its venues, the ladder teams that turn up as grudge matches, and the teams one of which ends it (the last leg ends in the final). gear: id, name, kind (bag, paddle, hat, partner, perk), rarity (common, uncommon, rare), icon (trip_gear_icons.png's cell, -1 the plain paddle's own icon), the two lines its card shows, and what it does. hazards: one modifier for the next match. detours: a page and two or three choices. ladder: the GARAGE's steps, in order. Text is the small font's: capitals, digits, spaces and !?.,:-'/%+, a line at most 30 characters on a card or 46 on a page.
